meaning:
ἐν-τυπόω, -ῶ
(τύπος), [in LXX for פִּתּוּחַ, Exo.39:30) A * ;]
to imprint, engrave: pass. ptcp., with dative, 2Co.3:7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for…
